create_DirWatcher: create a DirWatcher instance to monitor one or more directories for file modifications
calculate_most_recent_mtime: calculate the most recent file modification time across all watched directories
query_most_recent_change: query the most recent change timestamp with built-in one-second caching to avoid redundant scans
watch_single_directory: watch a single directory path by passing a string to the DirWatcher constructor
watch_multiple_directories: watch multiple directories by passing a list of paths to the DirWatcher constructor
